title: BP 商店默认双欢迎语缺少提供问候语时单条替换的前提

formal.clause: §6.1 BP入口与进场两条欢迎语
BP入口显示欢迎语与说明

prerequisites: Fixed reference, valid empty stock (or valid stock whose owned-important filtering succeeds), all normal scene/message dependencies succeed.
Caller supplies a nonnil bounded ordinary greeting text; custom greeting is an existing explicit argument, not a plugin alteration.
Observation is requested message sequence, not proof of rendering/sound or real map reachability.
ordinary_control: Omit greeting: two default introductory message requests, buy scene, two default farewell requests, normal price-clear tail.
minimal_counterexample: Supply greeting text Custom welcome: one introductory request containing that text, buy scene, same two default farewell requests. The default exchange-service introduction and explanatory second request are omitted.
cancel_exception_partial_commit: Cancel in purchase list still reaches two farewell messages and normal price-clear tail.
Stock already filtered before either greeting branch; cancel does not restore caller list.
If greeting/display or later scene fails, no ensure is present for farewells/price clearing; no general tail-cleanup guarantee.

negative_evidence.scope: All formal final set keyword locator scan; fully read WP66-C207 lines, BG C01–36, relevant B16/U05/U06 rows; necessary WP29:48–105; all Data/Scripts wrapper-name caller locator scan.
negative_evidence.result: WP66-C120 states two introductory messages without greeting=nil condition; WP29:88 likewise lacks explicit replacement. No relevant BG custom-greeting vector. Other test rows not fully audited by this child; no full131-spec absence claim.

impact: A later behavior test or clean-room UI may incorrectly always emit both defaults before/after a provided greeting. No transaction math changes.
minimal_repair: Qualify default BP introduction as two messages only when greeting absent; supplied greeting replaces both defaults with one message. Preserve two default normal farewell messages.
preserve_scope: Do not require a future concrete API, Ruby field names or source structure.
Do not infer actual demo event, media output, plugin behavior or exception recovery.
Preserve stock filtering, purchase prices/half display, refunds, stats and normal price-clear behavior.
synchronize: deliverables/final-specification-set/test-catalog/user-interface-wp17-63-65-66-67-68-69-70-71.md: one new greeting branch pair; existing C20/C29/C32 retained
acceptance_regressions: Absent greeting→2 default intro requests; supplied ordinary text→1 custom request.
Both normal return cases→same2 farewell requests and price-clear.
Important-stock list filtering still before greeting, same caller list retained; immediate cancel does not restore it.
dependencies: WP17 message request contract; WP29 BP wrapper

negative_evidence.scope: Full four assigned UI sources/fullWP66-C, allBG rows/relevantM10 rows, necessary full Bag/storage helper; WP27:86–128/153–168. Formal-set keyword search only locates other candidate statements.

impact: Omitted normal display-time state prevents precise UI tests and can misclassify display failure/pause as already-deleted inventory. The feature purpose explicitly distinguishes when resource writes occur.

preserve_scope: No reference patch or future defect-compatibility requirement.
Keep existing C12 end result, quantity cancel, important/Toss debug gates, unchecked returns, C36 bulk assertion and both shared-message contracts.
No native rendering/physical keys/media/demo claim, no mandatory future UI architecture.
